name: Frujai Colony
body:
FRUJAI COLONY
CR 19

XP 204,800
N Colossal plant
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +37

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 2, flat-footed 34 (–8 size, +32 natural)
hp 345 (30d8+210)
Fort +24, Ref +12, Will +16
Defensive Abilities absolute gravity; Immune plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +30 (4d6+15 B&P&S), 2 slams +29 (2d8+15 B)
Ranged gravity thrust +14 touch (12d8 force, max. 200 ft.)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks gravity control, slough minion 6

STATISTICS

Str 41 (+15), Dex 11 (+0), Con 25 (+7), Int 15 (+2), Wis 19 (+4), Cha 22 (+6)
Base Atk +22; CMB +45; CMD 55 (59 vs. bull rush or reposition, 61 vs. trip)
Feats Dazzling Display, Flyby Attack, Hover, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Point-blank Shot, Power Attack, Precise Shot, Shatter Defenses, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Climb +18, Fly +3, Intimidate +51, Knowledge (nature) +32, Perception +37, Stealth –16, Survival +19
Languages Frujai; telepathy 300 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Absolute Gravity (Su)

A frujai colony is able to control its apparent mass through a combination of organelles and psychic commands. It gains a +4 bonus to its CMD against bull rush, reposition, and trip combat maneuvers. Furthermore, it can ignore the effect of magical gravity effects such as reverse gravity and can always behave as though natural gravity conditions were up to two steps stronger or weaker.

Gravity Control (Su)

A frujai colony can control gravity in a variety of ways. At the beginning of its turn, a colony selects two of the following abilities that it can use before the beginning of its next turn. If a colony has a sustained ability active and does not select that as one of its abilities for the turn, that effect ends immediately.

Flight: As a free action, the frujai colony gains an extraordinary fly speed of 40 feet (poor maneuverability). When this ability ends, the colony descends gently at a rate of 60 feet per round and takes no damage when it lands.
Gravity Field: The frujai colony can create a zone of reversed gravity as a standard action, as per the reverse gravity spell (CL 19th). A colony can maintain only one such effect at a time, and the reversed gravity field ends if it uses this ability again.
Gravity Shield: A frujai colony combines levitating improvised shields with pulses of gravity to deflect attacks, gaining a +4 deflection bonus to its AC and CMD.
Gravity Thrust: The frujai colony can use its gravity thrust attack. This is a ranged touch attack with a maximum range of 200 feet and no range increment.
Gravity Wave: As a standard action, the frujai colony can unleash a wave of gravity in a 60-foot cone that deals 15d6 force damage to each creature in the area and pushes affected creatures 10 feet away from the colony. A target can attempt a DC 31 Reflex save to halve the damage and negate the movement. The saving throw is Charisma-based.
Slough Minion (Ex)

As a standard action up to 3 times per day, a colony can create a temporary frujai soldier in an adjacent space. The soldier can act immediately. A temporary soldier remains animate up to 1 hour before crumbling.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forests (Halochthon)
Organization solitary or communion (2–5)
Treasure standard

Frujai are sentient fungal colonies native to the toroid-shaped world of Halochthon.

Frujais are well-adapted to the planet’s constant, dramatic fluctuations of gravity, light, and temperature, and have developed both biological and psychic means of overcoming these obstacles.

In many ways, frujais function like insect colonies. The center of the colony is a massive, living hub that stands on three agile legs. It spawns dozens or even hundreds of smaller soldiers over the course of its lifetime to perform the detail work.

During the unpredictable and brutal winters, frujais hibernate, awakening during the thaw to blanket their territory in spores that infest the corpses of less fortunate creatures. If no such targets are available, the colony hunts aggressively to create a source for its spores to mature—attacking whatever living creatures it encounters.

The newly sprouted immature drones (use the statistics for a frujai soldier with the young template and without the colony guard ability) look somewhat like flightless birds. They scavenge and hunt ravenously to grow stronger; those that survive eventually become soldiers and seek a colony to join.

Frujai are surprisingly intelligent. They see themselves as caretakers of the natural order, weeding out weaker prey and maintaining ecological balance. They enjoy gathering and discussing their unique worldviews. Xenolinguists find the frujai language largely centered on abstract cycles, alien philosophies, and the joy of ravenous feasting. However, the frujais’ telepathic abilities allow them to communicate with most sentient creatures on a more practical level.
